_comment: Curated MCP server catalog for the in-app 'Browse catalog' picker. The catalog is a menu of opt-in suggestions — nothing is added to mcp.json or run until the user explicitly picks an entry. The entries below are the official reference servers from Anthropic's modelcontextprotocol/servers repo (all stdio, no API key). npx-based entries need Node; uvx-based entries need uv/uvx installed. To add more entries see the field shapes in src-tauri/src/commands/mcp.rs (McpCatalogItem) and docs/prds/2026-06-03-mcp-registration-ux.md.

servers.name: Filesystem
servers.description: Secure file operations with configurable access controls. Append one or more allowed directory paths to the arguments before adding.

servers.name: Fetch
servers.description: Fetch a web page and convert it to clean markdown for efficient LLM use.

servers.name: Memory
servers.description: Knowledge-graph-based persistent memory the model can read from and write to across turns.

servers.name: Git
servers.description: Read, search, and manipulate Git repositories. Optionally pass --repository <path> in the arguments.

servers.name: Sequential Thinking
servers.description: Dynamic, reflective problem-solving through a structured sequence of thoughts.

servers.name: Everything
servers.description: Reference/test server that exercises every MCP feature (prompts, resources, tools) — useful for trying things out.
